request.style: English, male solo voice with warm timbre, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft strings, hopeful and steady mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
With feet strapped by the gospel peace
Take up the shield of faith
Extinguish every flaming arrow
Of the evil one in his wrath

[Pre-Chorus]
Helmet of salvation on my head
Sword of the Spirit in my hand
The word of God is the blade
That cuts through the darkness in the land

[Chorus]
Pray in the Spirit at all times
With every kind of prayer and petition
Stay alert and persevere
For all the saints in this world

[Verse]
Pray for me that words may come
When I open my mouth to speak
Boldly make known the mystery
Of the gospel that I seek

[Chorus]
Pray in the Spirit at all times
With every kind of prayer and petition
Stay alert and persevere
For all the saints in this world

[Bridge]
An ambassador in chains I stand
Declare it fearlessly as I ought
So that you may know my path
And what I am doing in thought

[Outro]
Tychicus will tell you all
Our dear and faithful servant
Pray in the Spirit at all times
With every kind of prayer and petition
